post.summary: Publish a blog or news entry (V2.1).
post.description:
The endpoint used to publish the blog and news data. Only BlogNewsId is required in the request body.
            
**Changes from V2:**
- A BlogNewsId in the request body that differs from the route returns 400 Bad Request with "BlogNewsId in the route and request body must match."
- Activity and TargetPublishState are optional. TargetPublishState defaults to NONE when omitted, null or empty.
- A TargetPublishState other than NONE, PREVIEW or PRODUCTION (any letter case) returns 400 Bad Request with "TargetPublishState must be one of: NONE, PREVIEW, PRODUCTION." A valid value is sent to the publish in upper case.
- An inactive entry, an entry without a store, a PortalId that is not the entry's store, a LocaleId that is not an active locale of the store, or PREVIEW while preview is not enabled returns 400 Bad Request.
- A BlogNewsId that does not exist returns 404; no access to the entry's store returns 403.
- When the entry is published but the CMS page search index was not updated (an index run failed or did not complete), 500 is returned with a message that says so.
- Any other publish failure returns 500 with the generic message "Publish failed." and no exception details.
- Every 400, including request validation, has the same body: ZnodeErrorDetail with ErrorCode InvalidData and all invalid values in ErrorMessage.

parameters.name: blogNewsId
parameters.description: The ID of the blog news item to be published.

requestBody.description: The parameters required for publishing the blog news item.

400.description: Bad Request(The request contain invalid Data.)

403.description: Forbidden(The user does not have access to the store of the blog/news.)

404.description: Not Found(The BlogNewsId does not exist.)

500.description: Server Error(Indicates that an error occurred on the server.)

get.summary: List all blog/news entries (V2.1).
get.description:
V2.1 endpoint with proper filter support and enhanced validation.

**Changes from V2:**
- Filter field names preserve original casing for correct SQL column matching
- Filter values preserve original casing for case-sensitive comparisons
- Invalid pageSize (non-numeric) returns 400 Bad Request

**Supported Filter Operators:**
- `eq` - Equals (exact match)
- `cn` - Contains (substring match)
- `ncn` - Not Contains (does not contain substring)
- `ne` - Not Equals
- `gt`, `ge`, `lt`, `le` - Greater/Less than comparisons

**Supported Filter Fields:**
- BlogNewsId, BlogNewsCode, BlogNewsTitle, BlogNewsType
- StoreName, LocaleId, PublishStateId, PublishStatus
- Tags, SEOUrl, ActivationDate, ExpirationDate

**Filter Examples:**
- `filter=BlogNewsTitle~ncn~Blog` - Titles that do NOT contain "Blog"
- `filter=BlogNewsType~eq~News` - Only type "News"
- `filter=StoreName~cn~Maxwell's Hardware` - StoreName contains value
- `filter=LocaleId~ne~0` - LocaleId not equal to 0
- `filter=PublishStatus~eq~Production` - Only Production status
- `filter=Tags~eq~test123` - Exact tag match

parameters.description: A collection of filters with preserved casing for field names and values.

delete.description:
This API endpoint is used to delete cache data associated with specific keys.

- The API accepts up to 10 comma-separated keys in a single request.
- If null or empty keys are provided, the API will respond with a Bad Request (400) error.
- If more than 10 keys are provided, the API will respond with a Bad Request (400) error.
- If provided keys do not exist in the cache, the API will respond with a Not Found (404) error.
- If some keys are valid and others are not, the API will respond with a Bad Request (400) error.
- If all keys are valid, the API will delete the cache entries and return a 200 OK response.
- Ensure the keys provided are valid and exist in the cache for successful deletion.

get.summary: Retrieve webstore category details (V2.1).
get.description:
Retrieves one page of the published categories of a catalog, each with its active subcategories, with filtering, sorting and pagination.
            
**Changes from V2:**
- Only the documented filter fields (`PublishCategoryId`, `Name`, `CategoryCode`, `ZnodeCatalogId`, `ZnodeParentCategoryIds`, `ProductIds`, `LocaleId`, `IsActive`) and sort fields (`DisplayOrder`, `PublishCategoryId`) are accepted; anything else returns 400.
- A missing or unsupported filter operator, a missing filter name, a repeated filter, an expand other than `SubCategories` and an invalid sort return 400.
- Filter values are passed to the query as parameters, so a value can never change the query.
- `ZnodeCatalogId` (`eq` only) must equal the requested catalog; `LocaleId~eq` must be an active locale of the store and match `localeCode`.
- `ProductIds` filters match whole product ids; `ZnodeParentCategoryIds` supports only `eq~true`.
- Expired or not yet active categories are excluded in the query, so `TotalResults`/`TotalPages` match the categories returned.
- Sorting and paging are applied in the query with a stable order.
- `pageSize` defaults to 10 and must be between 1 and 1000.
- Every 400 response (including an unknown query parameter or an invalid pageIndex / pageSize) returns ZnodeErrorDetail with an ErrorMessage.
- A 500 response returns a generic message; the details are logged.

parameters.description: The code representing the locale to use for retrieving data.

parameters.description: The unique code of the store where the category is published.

post.summary: Send one paginated batch of customizable products from Znode to the external API.
post.description:
Calls dbo.Znode_GetCustomizableProducts to fetch a page of products with their
variants and variant attributes, builds a single nested JSON payload, posts it
to the external product-batch endpoint and returns the per-record success/failure response.
            
runType controls whether the SP returns everything ("Full") or only products
modified since the last daily run ("Diff", the default). For "Diff" runs the
service resolves the ScheduleDate cutoff internally; the caller does not pass it.
            
IMPORTANT:
  The external API may return HTTP 400 even on partial success
  (e.g. "Success: 9, Failed: 1."). In that case the response body still
  contains a valid per-record result list, so this endpoint normalises
  both 200 (all-success) and 400 (partial-failure) into the same
  Znode.Engine.Api.Models.CustomizableProductBatchResponseModel shape. The caller
  should inspect SuccessCount / FailureCount / Results[].IsSuccess to
  determine outcome.

put.summary: Update an existing form widget and email configuration.
put.description: Updates an existing form widget configuration and its associated email configuration, identified by the `widgetKey` path parameter. The request body must include `WidgetCode`, `FormBuilderId` and `TypeOFMapping`. The configuration to update is found by `widgetKey`, `FormBuilderId` and locale (`LocaleCode`, or the default locale when it is not provided). Updatable fields include the form title, button label, confirmation message, redirect URL, and email notification settings. In the request body, `WidgetsKey` is ignored (the path `widgetKey` is used); `WidgetCode` and `TypeOFMapping` are required but not saved; `CMSMappingId`, `IsShowCaptcha` and `EnableCMSPreview` are not updated. When `IsTextMessage` is true, `RedirectURL` is cleared; when it is false or omitted, `TextMessage` is cleared. The email settings are replaced with the values sent: an omitted `NotificationUserName` clears it, and an omitted template name saves template ID 0. When a form field changes or `NotificationUserName` is sent, the form widget must already have an email configuration; otherwise 400 is returned after the form fields have been saved. When nothing changes and no `NotificationUserName` is sent, 204 is returned.

parameters.name: widgetKey
parameters.description: The unique key that identifies the specific form widget instance to update. This key is assigned when the form widget is placed on a CMS page.

requestBody.description: The form widget and email configuration to update.

200.description: Success - The form widget configuration was successfully updated. The response contains the IsUpdated flag confirming whether the update was applied.

204.description: No Content - Nothing was updated: the form fields are unchanged and no NotificationUserName was sent. The response body is empty.

400.description: Bad Request - The request body is missing or malformed, a required field (WidgetCode, FormBuilderId or TypeOFMapping) is missing, a field value exceeds its maximum length or has an invalid type, the widgetKey path segment contains leading or trailing spaces, no form widget configuration exists for the widgetKey, FormBuilderId and locale, the LocaleCode is invalid, NotificationUserName contains an invalid email address, or the form widget has no email configuration.

404.description: Not Found - Returned when the service raises an error whose error code is not 400.

500.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred on the server while processing the request. Please try again later or contact support if the issue persists.

post.summary: Creates or updates payment settings for portal domains.
post.description:
Creates or updates payment configuration settings for one or more portal domains.
Each domain configuration can include certificate and key file information required
by the configured payment provider. Existing settings are updated on the basis of PaymentSettingsId when a matching
record is found; otherwise, a new record is created.
            
### Related APIs
            
- **GET** [Retrieve all payment settings for a portal](v2/payment-settings/portal/{portalId})
- **GET** [Retrieve payment settings for a specific domain](v2/payment-settings/domain/{domainId})
- **DELETE** [Delete a payment setting by ID](v2/payment-settings/{paymentSettingId})

requestBody.description:
The list of domain payment configurations to save. Each entry must include:
`PortalId` (example: `100`), `DomainId` (example: `100`),
`CertificateFileName` (example: `merchant.pem`), `KeyFileName` (example: `merchant-key.pem`),
`CertificateFile` (raw certificate bytes), and `KeyFile` (raw private key bytes).

200.description: **Success** - The payment settings were saved. The response body contains the save result and persisted configurations.

400.description: **Bad Request** - The request body is null or contains invalid data.

500.description: **Internal Server Error** - An unexpected error occurred on the server.

get.summary: Retrieves the current runtime status of portal publish and export operations.
get.description: This endpoint provides a real-time, read-only view of whether any portal publish or export processes are currently in progress. Intent: To help clients determine system readiness before initiating new publish or export tasks. Functionality: Returns the active/inactive state of long-running background operations related to portal publishing and data export. Behavior (Operational Context): Reflects the live execution state of backend publish and export workflows at the moment the request is processed. The response indicates whether these operations are currently running, queued, or idle within the system. Usage Scenario: Clients can call this endpoint to implement retry strategies, prevent duplicate operations, or display operation progress indicators in the UI.

get.summary: Issues a short lived access token for the page builder iframe.
get.description:
The admin application calls this before rendering the page builder iframe and appends the returned token to the iframe URL.
The token is bound to a single store and to the authenticated admin user making the request, and expires shortly after it is issued (ExpiresInSeconds), so the page builder must
redeem it for a session on first load rather than keeping it on the URL for the lifetime of the editing session.
The userId must match the logged in (session) user of the request, otherwise the request is refused with 403.
When storeCode is not passed (content block created at the global level) a global token, not bound to any store, is issued.

parameters.name: storeCode
parameters.description: The store code the token is bound to. Empty or not passed for a global content block.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The admin user requesting editor access. Must match the logged in session user.

200.description: Success(Indicates that the request is successfully executed and the response body return the data in VisualEditorAccessTokenResponse model.)

400.description: Bad Request(The request contain invalid Data.)

403.description: Forbidden. The user is not authorised to edit the requested store.

500.description: Server Error(Indicates that an error occurred on the server.)

post.summary: Validates a page builder access token and issues a fresh token for the editor context it carries.
post.description:
The page builder calls this once on first load to exchange the short lived token on the iframe URL for a
long lived session token, returned in AccessDetails along with its lifetime in hours.
Only the most recently issued token for a user and store is honoured: calling GetAccessToken again invalidates earlier
tokens, including a session token that has not yet expired.
An expired, tampered, superseded or no longer authorised token comes back with a null Token rather than as an error.

requestBody.description: The request consists of the access token.

200.description: Success(Indicates that the request is successfully executed and the response body return the data in VisualEditorAccessContextResponse model.)

400.description: Bad Request(The request contain invalid Data.)

500.description: Server Error(Indicates that an error occurred on the server.)

Properties.description:
A dictionary containing additional properties as key-value pairs for the import process.

Required properties based on the ImportType:

- **Product**: Requires "FamilyCode" as a key, whose value can be found in the PIM/ProductAttributeFamily/List in the admin panel.

- **Pricing**: Requires "PriceListCode" as a key, which can be found in the admin panel under Price/List.

- **Inventory**: No additional required properties.

- **Category**: Requires "FamilyCode" as a key, which can be found in the PIM/CategoryAttributeFamily/List in the admin panel.

- **ZipCode**: Requires "CountryName" as a key. The country name can be found in the admin /Country/List.

- **ProductAttribute**: No additional required properties.

- **CategoryAssociation**: No additional required properties.

- **Customer**: Requires "StoreCode" as a key. The store code can be found in the store configuration within the admin panel.

- **CustomerAddress**: No additional required properties.

- **ProductAssociation**: No additional required properties.

- **SEODetails**: Requires "StoreCode" as a key, which can be found in the admin store configuration.

- **Highlight**: No additional required properties.

- **AddonAssociation**: No additional required properties.

- **AttributeDefaultValue**: No additional required properties.

- **Voucher**: No additional required properties.

- **Account**: Requires "StoreCode" as a key. The store code can be found in the admin panel, specifically under the edit store section.

- **Synonyms**: No additional required properties.

- **CatalogCategoryAssociation**: Requires "CatalogCode" as a key, The catalog code can be found in the admin panel, PIM/Catalog/CatalogList.

- **Brands**: No additional required properties.

- **Promotions**: Requires "DiscountName" as a key. The discount name can be one of the following values: Amount Off BOGO, Amount Off Brand, Amount Off Catalog, Amount Off Category, Amount Off Displayed Product Price, Amount Off Order, Amount Off Product, Amount Off Shipping, Amount Off Shipping with carrier, Amount Off X If Y Purchased, Call For Pricing, Percent Off BOGO, Percent Off Brand, Percent Off Catalog, Percent Off Category, Percent Off Displayed Product Price, Percent Off Order, Percent Off Product, Percent Off Shipping, Percent Off Shipping with carrier, Percent Off X If Y Purchased.

- **SalesRep**: No additional required properties.

- **BStoreCustomer**: No additional required properties.
